# Mocksheets

> AI-powered Shopify catalog management platform.
> Analyze, optimize, and sync product titles, SEO meta, and descriptions in bulk — with human approval before every Shopify write.

## What is Mocksheets?

Mocksheets is a browser-based AI catalog operations tool built for Shopify merchants and e-commerce teams. Users import their Shopify product catalog, run AI-powered analyses and optimizations, review changes in a spreadsheet-like interface, and push only approved edits back to Shopify via OAuth.

The platform uses Anthropic Claude with a RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) pipeline trained on Turkish and English e-commerce command examples.

## Core Features

- **AI SEO Optimization** — Bulk-generate SEO titles, meta descriptions, and alt text for hundreds of products using AI
- **Bulk Product Description** — Create unique, conversion-focused descriptions for your entire catalog
- **Catalog Health Score** — 0–100 dashboard combining SEO + description + image + tag quality
- **Validation Center** — Detect and fix duplicates, missing data, inconsistent vendor names
- **Approval-First Sync** — Every AI suggestion goes through accept / skip / edit before writing to Shopify; unauthorized writes are blocked server-side
- **Change History** — Full before/after log; revert any change in one click
- **Shopify OAuth Integration** — read_products + write_products scopes; order/customer data read but not stored

## Who is it for?

- Shopify merchants (small to medium stores)
- E-commerce operations teams managing large catalogs
- Catalog managers and product managers
- Turkish e-commerce sellers (Shopify, Trendyol, Hepsiburada)

No credit card required for Free plan. Cancel anytime.

## Technology Stack

- Frontend: Vanilla JS, static HTML/CSS (Vercel)
- Backend: Node.js / Express (Render)
- Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL + pgvector)
- AI: Anthropic Claude 3 (prompt caching + RAG pipeline)
- Auth: Supabase JWT / Google OAuth
- Payments: Stripe
- Compliance: GDPR + KVKK compliant

## Privacy & Security

- Shopify OAuth with minimal required scopes (read_products, write_products)
- No order or customer data stored
- Access tokens encrypted at rest
- Disconnect your store at any time from settings

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Does Mocksheets change my store without my approval?**
A: No. Every change is previewed in the Validation Center. Only changes you explicitly approve are written to Shopify. Unapproved writes are blocked at the server level.

**Q: Can I start without a credit card?**
A: Yes. The Free plan requires no card. Sign in with Google in 30 seconds and get 5 free AI commands per day.

**Q: How does the Shopify connection work?**
A: OAuth with read_products and write_products scopes. Order/customer data is read for context but never stored. The access token is encrypted; disconnect anytime.

**Q: Can I undo AI changes?**
A: Yes. Every applied change has an old/new value recorded. Revert to the original with one click from Change History.

**Q: Does Mocksheets replace Yoast/Smart SEO?**
A: Partially. Mocksheets excels at bulk AI content generation and catalog health. Technical SEO (JSON-LD schema markup) is not yet covered — some teams use both.

**Q: What file formats are supported?**
A: Products sync directly from Shopify via API. PDF table extraction (OCR) is supported for data import.

**Q: Is there a bulk edit limit on the Free plan?**
A: Yes. Free plan: up to 5 products in catalog, 5 bulk AI operations per request. Pro and above: 100 per request, unlimited catalog size.
